propositions: Dockerized Jira 8.17.1 Server instance must build from vendored Dockerfile pinning addono base by digest, not pull an unpublished pycontribs image
Harness must start within 20 minutes on native amd64 runner, serving REST v2 at loopback-scoped 127.0.0.1:2990 with mandatory -DskipAllPrompts and -Dproduct.start.timeout flags in entrypoint
Personal Access Token authentication via Bearer tokens must work programmatically minted via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens against real Jira 8.17.1

Teardown must verify all created issues return 404 from direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoints without consulting search index, and fixture must refuse to run against stale residue from prior interrupted runs

Test suite under tests/external/live_jira_dc/ must be skipped without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 plus running harness, participate in jira_live canary requiring _live_jira_ready sentinel, and be structurally gated as external tier (never integration)

CI job in external-integration.yml must build harness, wait readiness, run only live_jira_dc tests on native amd64, tear down under if:always(), and pre-existing external job must add --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc to avoid masking DC canary with Cloud test execution
